BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION I. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the B1-2, Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as shown
on Map No. 8-G in the area bounded by:

a line 154.6 feet north of and parallel to West 33 Place; the public alley next east of and parallel to South
Morgan Street; a line 129.60 feet north of and parallel to West 334 Place; and South Morgan Street
to those of a Ct-1, Neighborhood Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 3317 South Morgan Strect, Chicago, IL 60608
